title: Beatrice d'Aragona to Eleonora d'Aragona, Buda, 8 March 1486 (DECODE R1142)

documents.shelfmark: State Archives of Modena, Carteggio Principi Esteri, 1623, b. 2/2, 2, 10

plaintext.source: MDE IV (1878), supplement no. 45, pp. 367-368 (cipher passage); MDE III no. 54 p. 67 (closing); Berzeviczy 1914 no. LVI (plain body)

transcription.source: MDE IV (1878), supplement no. 45, pp. 367-368 (cipher passage); MDE III no. 54 p. 67 (closing); Berzeviczy 1914 no. LVI (plain body)
transcription.notes: Published reading located and selected passages matched to manuscript; no fresh exhaustive glyph transcript.

system.summary: A graphic substitution alphabet, by the letter's own statement the old cipher between Beatrice and Eleonora, for passages on the first page; not reconstructed here.
system.notes: The closing paragraph says this letter uses the cipher the correspondents had of old and encloses a new one; whether the old one is the 1482 alphabet (beatrice1482) is not established (RESULT.md: the 1482 and 1486 alphabets look different). The printed reading keeps 'Virtus', 'Fortis' and repeated 'M.', whose role is not established.

prior_solution.where: MDE IV (1878), supplement no. 45, pp. 367-368 (the cipher passages); MDE III (1877) no. 54, p. 67 (the closing); Berzeviczy (1914) no. LVI (the plain body)

conditions.human_role: Supplied target catalogue entry and pointed out available DECODE cookie.

solution.what: Extracted five exact dates, recipients and shelfmarks from cached DECODE metadata; web reader could not open live DECODE page.
Retrieved Cryptiana index and Berzeviczy 1914 OCR. Located 8 March 1486 letter in no. LVI, not yet compared to cipher.
Used existing user-authorized DECODE cookie to acquire all 18 images. R1143 has repeated photographs with decipherment slips moved.
Located MDE III nos. 10 and 12 for both 1482 letters, III no. 75 for May 1486, IV supplement no. 45 for March cipher and III no. 54 for its closing.

Matched dates, clear wording, cipher boundaries and R1143 manuscript slips to older readings. Rendered print confirms italics and March Virtus/Fortis/M. markers. No exhaustive key verification claimed.

Entry split from beatrice1482 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): R1142 announces a change of cipher, and its alphabet looks different from the 1482 one; not grouped with R1143 either, whose key is not shown to be the same.

outcome.method_basis: The cipher passages were already deciphered in print in MDE IV (1878), supplement no. 45, the closing in MDE III no. 54 and the plain body in Berzeviczy (1914) no. LVI; the prints were matched to the DECODE images and no key was applied.
outcome.notes: Andriolo to be brought to Hungary (the editor links the negotiation to the Djem affair). The printed reading keeps unexplained Virtus/Fortis/M. markers. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from beatrice1482.

credits.note: printed decipherment in MDE IV (1878) suppl. no. 45 and the closing in MDE III no. 54, matched to the images
1914 edition no. LVI prints the plain body of the letter
